case_name: State of Tamil Nadu v M. Krishnappan and others
facts: The question which arises for determination in these civil appeals is - whether
holding: The impugned levy of life time tax is based on rational and reasonable classification founded on an intelligible differentia having a rational relation to the object of the impugned levy.
There is no violation of article 14 of the Constitution.
